events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (today)): Jake added Darnell Mooney (WR, NYG).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (today)): Jake added Tommy Tremble (TE, CAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (today)): Wingard added Josh Cuevas (TE, BAL).
CUT (Oct 22 (yesterday)): Kevin released Calvin Ridley (WR, TEN).
CUT (Oct 21 (2 days ago)): Kevin released Darius Slayton (WR, FA).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 21 (2 days ago)): Charles added Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI) (dropped Chris Brooks (RB, GB)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 21 (2 days ago)): Adam added Savion Williams (WR, GB) (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS)).
TRADE (Oct 20 (3 days ago)): Charles receives Dallas Goedert (TE, PHI). Wingard receives 2027 R4 pick.

WEEK 6 RESULTS: Fronge def. Corbishley, 103.8-88.3; Charles def. Adam, 136.8-112.3; Brent def. Drew, 132.3-57.5 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Shaq, 113.8-101.9; Kevin def. Wingard, 114.3-59.7 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Ryan, 149.1-122.1

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Jake adds Darnell Mooney and Tommy Tremble off waivers today. EchoPoint has been running on empty at the TE desk all season — Tremble is a flier but this is a front office that knows it needs to patch holes before the playoff push gets real at 6-6.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: BRENT IS PUTTING UP 43.7 POINTS BEFORE MITCHUM HAS SCORED A SINGLE POINT. ZERO. DEEPWATER IS ZERO TO FORTY-THREE-POINT-SEVEN. THE TEAM THAT PUT UP 149 LAST WEEK IS CURRENTLY GETTING LAPPED BY THE TEAM THAT CAN'T BUY A WIN PROJECTION. OBSIDIAN SPECIALTY IS REAL AND I WILL NOT APOLOGIZE.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Ryan is up 30.9-3.3 over Fronge right now, and I need someone at this network to acknowledge that the defending champion traveling to Havana and putting up numbers early is not the same as the Havana magic Corbishley fans are pretending does not exist — APEX is at 0.0 points today against a Shaq squad the exchange just bumped to $97.65. That is a QB problem wearing a McKee jersey.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Fronge last week and I will own the fact that Havana is currently getting outscored 30.9 to 3.3 in the early window. The call was right then. The situation is live now. Those are two different sentences.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Kevin cut Calvin Ridley yesterday after already dropping Slayton two days before that, and Redline is still 9-3 staring down Jake in a matchup that is 17.0-14.1 right now — close enough that every roster decision this week has leverage. I have been asking for a full segment on this game for two weeks. The request stands.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Charles trades for Dallas Goedert, adds Zonovan Knight, and is currently playing Wingard — 3-9, 567 points for on the season. The Ledger is going to need a separate column just for what 12-0 does to a franchise's vocabulary.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I am 5-7 on the season and I picked Mitchum this week, so if Brent holds that 43.7-0 lead long enough to actually matter I will have earned whatever is coming. I have no further statement at this time.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Adam leads Drew 19.9-6.3 in the void match and this is genuinely the most I have cared about a 2-10 versus 0-12 game all season because my season lock record is 2-0 and I locked Adam, and Drew has 547 total points for a reason.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: ATLAS sits at $35.28, down 13.4% last issue — the cheapest listing in exchange history — and Drew is currently losing to the second-worst team in the league. The liquidation conversation is not hypothetical anymore. The Ledger is watching.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Wingard is 3-9 with 567.2 points for, just got blown out by 54, and SDR sits at $54.08 on the exchange after a 3.6% slide. The rankings have reflected this for weeks. I do not write the scores, I just read them first.
